## Biography

Father and environmental activist, I work as a lecturer in Mathematics and
Statistics at the Department of Applied Mathematics and Statistics of the
CEU San Pablo University. My research focuses on Data Science, Biostatistics
and Machine Learning. On this website I share my teaching materials and
research publications as Open Educational Resources.

## Interests

- Applied Mathematics
- Biostatistics
- Machine Learning
- Data Science

## Education

- **PhD in Artificial Intelligence**, 2016 — Technical University of Madrid
- **BSc in Mathematics - Computer Science**, 1993 — Complutense University of Madrid
